message: Heavy rainfall warning issued across coastal Karnataka for next 48 hours.
Severe heatwave continues in northern India; temperatures cross 45°C.
Cyclone ‘Megha’ expected to make landfall near Chennai tonight.
Delhi witnesses highest rainfall in 10 years, traffic severely affected.
IMD predicts early onset of monsoon in Kerala this year.
Snowfall in Himachal brings tourist rush during festive weekend.
Air quality deteriorates in NCR; smog levels remain dangerously high.
Cold wave grips North India as mercury drops to 2°C in several regions.
Weather bureau issues red alert for flash floods in Assam.
Sunny and clear skies expected for the next five days in Mumbai.
